name: define-research-tasks
description: /wtfMS:define-research-tasks measured from a frozen post-virtual-lab state. Builds the WORKFLOW.md task list.

measure.prompt:
/wtfMS:define-research-tasks

Run FULLY AUTONOMOUSLY: do NOT call AskUserQuestion, do NOT run any git commands (no init/add/commit). Use reasonable defaults for anything unspecified. Complete the whole skill end-to-end.

Build the workflow from scratch for this literature-synthesis project. Use a
sensible ~4-task plan: (1) extract process-defect datapoints from the published
LPBF Ti-6Al-4V literature, (2) compile and clean them into one analysis dataset,
(3) statistical analysis + build the VED-based defect processing map, (4)
synthesize findings and limitations. Make reasonable assumptions per task. Write
.research/WORKFLOW.md via the wtfms-workflow-planner subagent. Stop at WORKFLOW COMPLETE.
